draft.shortGloss: to watch; to look at; to examine
draft.emotion: relaxed and attentive, focused on a screen or an object
notes: Imperfective verb; its perfective partner is 'obejrzeć'.
Implies spending time watching or looking at something, unlike 'widzieć' (to see) or 'patrzeć' (to look).

senses.definition: To look at something for a period of time, such as a film, television programme, or match.

examples.translation: I like to watch movies on weekends.
examples.emotion: content and peaceful, describing a favorite leisure activity

senses.definition: To look at something carefully in order to inspect it or see what it is like.

examples.text: Klienci chętnie oglądają nowe produkty w sklepie.
examples.translation: Customers gladly look at the new products in the shop.
